clue.text: Articles about the city

indicators.note: about means going round, so one piece is placed around the other here

parts.note: an is an indefinite article, so two of them are ans
taken as written

explanation.surface: A guidebook's articles about a famous city.
explanation.walkthrough: Solvers expect 'Articles' to give A and THE; here it is the plural of the article 'an'. 'about' signals the wrapping.
explanation.definitionFit: Athens is a capital, the chief Greek metropolis.

clue.text: Object to girl whose name you can't remember

definitions.text: Object to girl whose name you can't remember

parts.note: a thing is an object
Amy is a girl's name

explanation.surface: A forgotten girl is the object of attention.
explanation.definitionFit: A thingamy is a placeholder word for any item or person whose proper name escapes one.

clue.text: Transport to the door

explanation.surface: Carrying someone to the doorstep.
explanation.definitionFit: To entrance is to enrapture or carry away with delight; an entrance is a way in, such as a doorway.

clue.text: Ridiculous rules in ship causing bad temper

indicators.note: ridiculous means absurd, so the letters are thrown into a new order

parts.note: SS is short for steamship

explanation.surface: Absurd regulations aboard a vessel make the crew grumpy.
explanation.definitionFit: Surliness is sullen rudeness, an unfriendly ill humour.

clue.text: Again thinking about kindness to others

parts.note: re means about or concerning
consideration is thoughtfulness for other people

explanation.surface: Thinking twice about being kind to people.
explanation.definitionFit: Reconsideration is thinking a matter over a second time.

clue.text: Publicise protection of communications

definitions.note: a mass noun, letters sent by aeroplane

parts.note: to air views is to publicise them
mail is armour, protection for a knight

explanation.surface: Promoting the safeguarding of messages.
explanation.definitionFit: Airmail is post carried by aircraft, a form of correspondence.

clue.text: Under pressure Liberal MEP lied clumsily

indicators.note: clumsily means awkwardly, so the letters are mixed up

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A Liberal Euro-MP told awkward fibs when pressed.
explanation.definitionFit: To be impelled is to be driven or compelled by force.

clue.text: Girl loses a friend in the usual way

indicators.note: loses means gives up, so a letter drops out of the girl's name

parts.note: Norma is a girl's name
an ally is a friend or supporter

explanation.surface: A woman loses a companion, as usually happens.
explanation.definitionFit: Normally means ordinarily, as a rule.

clue.text: Call by philosopher to cherish educational skill about the past

parts.note: hi is a call of greeting

indicators.note: to cherish is to hold close, so the philosopher's word holds the skill inside it

parts.note: a Stoic is a follower of the philosopher Zeno
R is one of the three Rs, the basic skills of school (reading, writing, arithmetic)

explanation.surface: A thinker summons up the art of teaching from times gone by.
explanation.walkthrough: The 'educational skill' is one of the three Rs (reading, writing, arithmetic); 'to cherish' signals holding it inside.
explanation.definitionFit: Historic is used loosely for historical, concerning or belonging to earlier times.

clue.text: Becoming respectable

explanation.surface: Something becoming socially acceptable.
explanation.definitionFit: Proper means fitting or seemly (becoming), and also decent and conventional in behaviour (respectable).

clue.text: Republican in Niagara Falls is a land reformer

indicators.note: in places the abbreviation inside the rearranged letters
falls suggests the letters tumble into a new order

explanation.surface: A Republican politician at Niagara Falls is campaigning for land reform.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Falls' looks like part of the place name, but it rearranges NIAGARA; 'in' then puts R inside.
explanation.definitionFit: An agrarian is someone who advocates redistributing landholdings, a supporter of rural reform.

clue.text: Flower in trouble had receded

indicators.note: receded means went back, so the pieces are read backwards

parts.note: to ail is to trouble, as an illness troubles someone
taken as written

explanation.surface: A flower in difficulties has withered away.
explanation.walkthrough: 'receded' turns AIL followed by HAD, giving the run in reverse.
explanation.definitionFit: The dahlia is a garden plant with showy blooms, named after the botanist Dahl.

clue.text: Rebel Muscovite left for this sort of warfare

parts.note: Che Guevara is the archetypal rebel
muscovite is a form of mica, a mineral, not a person from Moscow

explanation.surface: A Russian insurgent has abandoned a kind of combat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Muscovite' looks like a citizen of Moscow, but it is a mineral, potash mica.
explanation.definitionFit: Chemical warfare uses poison gases and toxins as weapons.

clue.text: Sailors hunched round the gold, imbibing

indicators.note: round means surrounding, so the sailors and the hunched word go about the metal

parts.note: ABs are able seamen
bent means stooped or hunched
or is gold in heraldry

explanation.surface: Seamen bent over the treasure, drinking.
explanation.walkthrough: Or is the heraldic word for gold; 'round' signals the sailors and the hunched word going about it.
explanation.definitionFit: Absorbent means soaking up liquid, taking it in.

clue.text: Farm building built by soldiers

parts.note: taken as written
RE, the Royal Engineers, is a British Army corps

explanation.surface: A barn put up by army men.
explanation.definitionFit: A byre is a cowshed, a shelter for cattle.

clue.text: Police chief covered function with bugs

indicators.note: covered means enclosed, so the chief's name goes around the other word

parts.note: Lavrenti Beria headed Stalin's secret police
an act is a function or deed

explanation.surface: A police chief kept the event under wraps, using hidden microphones.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bugs' suggests listening devices; it means germs.
explanation.definitionFit: Bacteria are microbes, and bugs is everyday slang for germs.

clue.text: Getting ready to fight to set up a dynasty

parts.note: to rear is to raise or set up
the Ming dynasty ruled China

explanation.surface: Preparing for war to found a ruling house.
explanation.definitionFit: Rearming is acquiring weapons again, preparing for war.

clue.text: This man's in a whirl

parts.note: read as a man's name and also as a swirl of water, a spinning current

explanation.surface: A man is in a dizzy state.
explanation.definitionFit: An eddy is a circular current in water, and Eddy is also a familiar form of Edward.

clue.text: Fruit tree gave rise to the Fall? That's right!'

indicators.note: rise in a down clue means the word is read upwards

parts.note: a lapse is a fall from grace, as in the Fall of Man
ie, id est, means that is

explanation.surface: An apple tree caused Adam's fall from grace, as it should.
explanation.walkthrough: 'gave rise to' reads LAPSE upwards as ESPAL; 'That's' is IE.
explanation.definitionFit: An espalier is a fruit tree trained flat against a wall or frame.

clue.text: Produce note in Pitman for boss

parts.note: to do is to produce or make

indicators.note: in places the musical note inside the pit worker

parts.note: a pitman is a coal miner
E is a musical note

explanation.surface: Writing down a note in Pitman shorthand for the manager.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pitman' suggests the shorthand system; it is a pit worker.
explanation.definitionFit: To domineer is to order people about, as a tyrannical boss does.

clue.text: Evaluates a series of points

parts.note: S, SE, S, SE, S strings together compass points, south and south-east

explanation.surface: Someone judges a list of points in an argument.
explanation.walkthrough: The 'points' are compass points, not points of argument.
explanation.definitionFit: To assess is to judge the worth or quality of something.

clue.text: A telephone that's run for the workshop

parts.note: ie, id est, means that is
R is the cricket abbreviation for run

explanation.surface: A phone line operated for the studio.
explanation.definitionFit: An atelier is an artist's or designer's studio.

clue.text: Sailor has to achieve his ambition

parts.note: tar is an old word for a seaman
to get is to obtain or achieve

explanation.surface: A seaman must reach his life's goal.
explanation.definitionFit: A target is an aim or objective one strives for.

clue.text: Get a doctor if I have a spasm in the sea

parts.note: a tic is a twitch, an involuntary spasm

explanation.surface: Call a physician if I start twitching while out on the water.
explanation.definitionFit: The Adriatic is the arm of the Mediterranean between Italy and the Balkans.

clue.text: Cultivating nearly all fruit

indicators.note: nearly all means the word is cut short by its final letter

parts.note: raising crops is cultivating them

explanation.surface: Growing almost every kind of fruit.
explanation.definitionFit: A raisin is a dried grape.

clue.text: Bizarre demise — it must be documented

indicators.note: bizarre means weird, so the letters are put in an odd new order

explanation.surface: A strange death that has to be recorded.
explanation.definitionFit: Itemised means listed item by item, set down in a record.

clue.text: Real gain made by an African

indicators.note: made means fashioned, so these letters are formed into a new word

explanation.surface: A genuine profit earned by someone from Africa.
explanation.definitionFit: An Algerian is a native of Algeria in North Africa.

clue.text: Fighter in the ring rushed right round

parts.note: tore means rushed, as in tore down the road
O is round in shape

explanation.surface: A boxer hurried round the ring to the right.
explanation.walkthrough: The 'ring' sounds like boxing, but it is the bullring.
explanation.definitionFit: A torero is a bullfighter, especially one on foot.
